excerpt: We report on the measurement of the $\gamma p \rightarrow J/\psi p$ cross section from $E_\gamma = 11.8$ GeV down to the threshold at $8.2$ GeV using a tagged photon beam with the GlueX experiment. title: First measurement of near-threshold J/$\psi $ exclusive photoproduction off the proton
